exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Collection
exploitedBy.relevance: Unclassified PII in email bodies is directly at risk of being harvested through email collection techniques by adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Addresses
exploitedBy.relevance: PII in email bodies often includes email addresses that adversaries can gather for reconnaissance or targeting purposes.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Hiding Rules
exploitedBy.relevance: Attackers may use email hiding rules to obscure indefinitely retained PII-bearing messages from detection or compliance review.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Local Email Collection
exploitedBy.relevance: Plaintext PII in email attachments can be locally collected by adversaries with access to the mail client or storage.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Remote Email Collection
exploitedBy.relevance: Plaintext PII attachments are susceptible to remote email collection by attackers accessing mail servers or cloud email systems.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Additional Email Delegate Permissions
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessive mailbox access grants directly correspond to the abuse or misconfiguration of email delegate permissions exposing PII data.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Forwarding Rule
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessive access grants may be exploited to create forwarding rules that exfiltrate PII-containing emails to unauthorized recipients.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
exploitedBy.relevance: Routing PII-bearing emails across borders may involve transferring data to foreign cloud accounts, aligning with this exfiltration technique.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Lifecycle-Triggered Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate disposal of deleted PII emails directly relates to failures in lifecycle-triggered deletion policies that should permanently remove sensitive data.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Clear Mailbox Data
exploitedBy.relevance: Proper disposal of deleted PII emails requires effective mailbox data clearing; inadequacy here leaves residual PII accessible.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Destruction
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate disposal procedures fail to ensure complete data destruction of PII-containing emails, leaving them recoverable.
